description: Should I buy, hold, or sell crypto this week? Get weekly position signals for Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), and Solana (SOL) scored 0-100 with strong buy, buy, hold, sell, and strong sell recommendations. Use this when someone wants trading signals or portfolio allocation guidance. Signal scale: 0-20 strong sell, 20-40 sell, 40-60 hold, 60-80 buy, 80-100 strong buy. Human-curated by analysts. Price: $1.00 USDC via x402.

payment_proof.description: x402 payment proof from a completed USDC payment on Base. Call this tool once without payment_proof to get payment details, then again with the proof after paying.

name: get_crypto_signals
